architecture.name: local_tied
architecture.head_groups: Each real key belongs only to its vertex-ID residue shard. Every shard is nonempty.
architecture.coefficient_accounting: Four Q/K/V/O scalars per shard, four residual MLP scalars per stored stage, plus four common-shape classifier scalars. Coefficients are shared across vertices and, for relation squaring, across relation coordinates.
architecture.structural_operations: Given adjacency, vertex-ID coordinates, identity edges, structural masks, null token, residual sum, softmax, ReLU, and endpoint selection.
